run performs seal verification and checks both fixed destinations, both attempt files, both score outputs and pair output before the first emulator construction.

Scoring checks all sealed source hashes before and after the full unfiltered frame loop. Existing score destinations are rejected.
The unchanged cold engine source also verifies its ROM fingerprint and pinned ALE binary before loading the game; no ROM bytes were read by this review.
